headline: 喵喵科技被曝财务造假，CEO 连夜跑路
content: 据知情人士透露，喵喵科技过去三年的猫粮销售额存在大量虚构。监管部门已介入调查。

en-US.headline: Meow Technologies accused of accounting fraud, CEO flees overnight
en-US.content: Sources say three years of cat-food revenue were fabricated. Regulators have opened an investigation.

es-ES.headline: Acusan a Miau Tecnologías de fraude contable y su CEO huye de madrugada

content: 一条推文引发散户狂欢，汪汪币社区连夜刷屏。
